tasarimlar.ad: Portable Cable Winder - Phone Stand Version
tasarimlar.lisans_kaniti: "This work is licensed under a Creative Commons (4.0 International License)"
tasarimlar.aciklama: This is a compact cable winder with a small added base so it can also act as a phone stand while closed. The model appears as a simple, low-profile single-piece object in the photos, with a curved body and a small support foot for the phone. The page says it is intended for holding a phone while charging and watching videos hands-free.
tasarimlar.neden_populer: Kablo düzenleme ile telefon standını tek nesnede birleştirdiği için hem pratik hem de görsel olarak dikkat çekici.

tasarimlar.ad: 2x4 Gridfinity sewing Thread & Bobbin Holder (7-slot, stackable)
tasarimlar.lisans_kaniti: "This work is licensed under a Creative Commons (4.0 International License)"
tasarimlar.aciklama: This is a stackable Gridfinity-style holder for sewing thread spools and bobbins with seven slots. The description specifies a 2x4 footprint and two height variants, and the model is presented as a clean modular organizer piece rather than a single decorative object. It is designed to print flat on a Gridfinity base and appears as a neatly segmented rectangular organizer.
tasarimlar.neden_populer: Modüler Gridfinity ekosistemiyle uyumlu olması ve düzenli, kullanışlı bir masa/raf parçası sunması nedeniyle popüler.
